method: Purposeful qualitative review, not a representative vacancy census. Eight advert profiles: five junior/entry-route examples and three experienced-role comparators. Full-text pages, indexed employer text and inaccessible pages are distinguished. Nearby East London and Kent examples are not labelled South-East London jobs.

adverts.level: Entry-friendly reporting example; not explicitly titled junior
adverts.status: Historical: advertised closing date 2 March 2026; direct fetch reached verification screen
adverts.access: Employer search-index excerpt; direct page access limited
adverts.signals: Excel formulas and data manipulation; Power BI learning; accuracy, dashboards and stakeholder communication
adverts.decision: Supports an Excel/reporting-first application route. No evidence that every entry role requires Python or SQL.

adverts.status: Expired in indexed employer page; September 2026 intake. Direct fetch reached verification screen
adverts.access: Detailed employer search-index text; direct page access limited
adverts.signals: Analysis, coding, visualisation, automation and non-technical communication; qualification, residency and right-to-work conditions
adverts.decision: Add apprenticeships as an optional entry route. Check each future advert and current funding rules; do not generalise this advert's residency condition to every apprenticeship.

adverts.region: Canterbury, Kent — adjacent-market comparator, not Brighton or SE London
adverts.status: Employer page accessible with Apply Now on review date; recheck before applying
adverts.signals: Advanced Excel, PivotTables, Power Query, formulas, cleansing, audit trails, GDPR, documentation and stakeholders; no explicit SQL/Python requirement in the read specification
adverts.decision: Strengthen data-quality evidence, documented checks and privacy. Canterbury is a separate commute decision; no salary inferred from aggregator estimates.

adverts.region: Canary Wharf E14 — East London, not South-East London
adverts.status: NHS Jobs explicitly says closed; posted 29 September 2026
adverts.access: Full NHS Jobs advert and displayed person specification read
adverts.signals: MS SQL Server and BI tools, reporting, quality and communication; NHS standard definitions and reporting knowledge essential; automation tools desirable; advert also lists Visual Basic/HTML among technology experience
adverts.decision: Add a short SQL Server/T-SQL bridge and an optional NHS domain pack. A general portfolio does not automatically satisfy NHS essential criteria; do not turn one advert's legacy technologies into a universal syllabus.

adverts.region: London / City — wider-London comparator, not verified SE London base
adverts.status: Employer URL now redirects to Vacancy not found; historical indexed specification only
adverts.access: Detailed employer search-index text; direct fetch confirmed vacancy-not-found redirect
adverts.signals: Power BI, Excel, numerical and concise communication skills; Python highly beneficial; expected PL-300 within six-month probation; basic financial-services context
adverts.decision: Keep Python as a useful differentiator. PL-300 can be employer-specific after hiring, not a universal prerequisite or a promised sponsored exam.

adverts.region: Dartford DA2; trust serves Bexley, Bromley and Greenwich
adverts.status: NHS Jobs explicitly closed; posted 4 March 2026
adverts.access: Full advert duties and experience requirement read
adverts.signals: Minimum three years SQL/database/warehouse experience; SQL, SSRS, Excel, Power BI; data quality and staff supervision
adverts.decision: Local ecosystem signal only. Do not require three years' experience, stored procedures/triggers or people management before beginning junior applications.

adverts.access: Detailed NHS Jobs search result / person-specification text read
adverts.signals: Advanced SQL and Excel, Python/R forecasting, Power BI/SSRS, NHS datasets and information governance; significant experience
adverts.decision: Confirms relevant local stack but advanced forecasting, optimisation and expert SQL are later specialisms, not a junior baseline.

adverts.role: Senior Data and Insights Analyst (body: Senior Data and Reporting Analyst)
adverts.status: Employer page accessible; posted 2 October 2026; not counted as a junior opportunity
adverts.access: Full employer responsibilities and requirements read
adverts.signals: Excel, Power Query, Power BI/DAX, SQL, governance, lineage, controlled change and automation; Python/Power Automate preferred; legacy VBA advantageous
adverts.decision: Add lightweight report handover/change-log concepts now. Keep Power Automate, VBA and advanced platform engineering optional, not compulsory junior tools.

course_sources.name: Excel course outline
course_sources.checked: Module list and file-download warning read; eight chapters plus projects. Paid problem packs/certificate distinguished on creator page.

course_sources.name: SQL foundations
course_sources.checked: Creator confirms free 4+ hour video and PostgreSQL project. Free dataset is historical 2023; supporter problems/certificate are paid.

course_sources.name: Intermediate SQL
course_sources.checked: Creator confirms free 6+ hour video, Contoso dataset and PostgreSQL workflow; use selected window/date/cleaning lessons, not another whole compulsory course.

course_sources.name: Old SQL course
course_sources.checked: Published chapter list inspected: MySQL basics, joins, nested queries and schema design; no CTE/window-function chapters listed. Not a sufficient sole resource for the roadmap.

course_sources.name: Power BI course outline
course_sources.checked: Grand Tour, Visualizations, Power Query and DAX plus projects. Full files should be downloaded using creator's Google Drive link due to repository size limits. Do not infer complete Service/security or current exam coverage from the outline.

course_sources.name: Python course outline
course_sources.checked: Basics, advanced pandas/Matplotlib and project. Use current notebooks; observed compatibility fixes mean copying older video syntax is not always sufficient.

course_sources.name: Current PL-300 study guide
course_sources.checked: Skills as of 20 April 2026: prepare 25–30%, model 25–30%, visualize/analyze 25–30%, manage/secure 15–20%. Includes Service, gateway/refresh, roles/RLS, sensitivity, performance, mobile and accessibility; also newer exam-specific topics.

course_sources.name: T-SQL learning path
course_sources.checked: Official search result identifies querying and modifying with T-SQL; used as bridge resource, not a replacement mandatory database course.

course_sources.name: T-SQL window lesson
course_sources.checked: Official learning objectives: OVER, ranking, aggregate and offset functions.

course_sources.name: UK GDPR principles
course_sources.checked: Official principles include minimisation, accuracy, security, purpose/storage limitation and accountability. This roadmap is not legal training or legal advice.
